answer: Sybil resistance works when influence is minted, not printed. Like copper coinage, every vote carries weight only if it was smelted from something scarce: locked stake that is actually slashed on dishonesty. Peers pull each contribution through a single verification thread that anyone can follow end to end, so a swarm of fake identities cannot hide where its outputs fail to replay. Rewards pool in a lagoon that only verifiable workers can enter - clones mill around the shore, and the gate stays closed.
